brief.text: FOX features the largest transaction on the dashboard by far, with Exec Chair and CEO Lachlan Murdoch purchasing $10,274,977 in shares, well above the next largest individual purchase of $1,999,991 at MNR. In cluster activity, Avidia Bancorp (AVBC) drew the broadest participation with five distinct insiders buying $586,569 in total, while Angel Studios (ANGX) logged the highest group total at $5,857,056 across three buyers. Additionally, consumer brands saw repeated activity, led by Celsius Holdings (CELH) at $1,830,043 from three insiders and Crocs (CROX) registering separate director purchases totaling $175,041.
